files.name: motion-prompt-056.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Toast notification" (トースト), one of the names in "UI component names".
Motion Prompt #056

What it is: A short message appears in a corner and goes away on its own
What the sample shows: Clicking "Save" slides a dark notice into the bottom-right corner; when its time bar runs out it slides away.
Spec:
- 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. The cursor clicks the blue "Save" button (110×36, bottom left) at 1.0 s and leaves to the bottom left.
- Toast: #26282c, 214×52, radius 10, 18 px from the right and 16 px from the bottom; slides in 240 px from the right over 1.05–1.4 s with easeOutCubic.
- Inside: a white check in a blue circle and white 15 px text "Saved".
- A time-left line along the bottom (3 px tall) shrinks linearly from 194 px to 0 over 1.4–3.2 s.
- Exit: slides 240 px out to the right over 3.2–3.55 s with easeInOutCubic.
When to use it: Use it to confirm a result such as a save or send without interrupting the user.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/056.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/ui.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
